response.original_title: {Room™~Addition~@} How to add another room on a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: To add a new room to your existing Princess Cruise, contact ☎ +1-844-375-4179 (US) or ☎ +44-808-196-9697 (UK) Princess’s reservations department or your travel advisor directly. Princess’s online portal does not support adding additional staterooms to an existing booking.  To add an entirely new room to your existing Princess Cruise reservation, you must call Princess directly at ☎ +1-844-375-4179 (US) or ☎ +44-808-196-9697 (UK) or contact your travel advisor, as this cannot be done online.
